english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for dealing effectively with a difficult situation, task, or demand.
Use this for coping with or managing a difficult situation that one has to live with.
Use this for coping with or dealing with a difficulty, rather than for negotiating an agreement.

examples.english: This report is so difficult, but I can cope with it.
examples.traditional: 呢份報告咁難，我都應付到。

examples.english: We have to learn to live with this kind of pressure.
examples.traditional: 我哋要學識應付呢種壓力。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hok6 sik1 jing1 fu6 nei1 zung2 aat3 lik6

examples.english: I can negotiate this mess on my own.
examples.traditional: 我一個人都應付到呢個爛攤子。
